### Welcome to my personal website!

I am a social scientist, quantitative researcher, [{{< fa brands r-project >}}](https://www.r-project.org/about.html) enthusiast, and a Master’s student in [Sociology at the University of São Paulo (USP)](https://ppgsociologia.fflch.usp.br/). I study social inequality and violence with a focus on applying computational statistics and spatial analysis to understand criminal data and urban dynamics.

Currently, I'm a Visiting Postgraduate Researcher (VPGR) at the [Department of Criminology, University of Manchester](https://www.humanities.manchester.ac.uk/criminology/research/postgraduate-research/), under the supervision of [Dr. Thiago R. Oliveira](https://www.thiagoroliveira.com/), with funding from The São Paulo Research Foundation. My main goal here is to develop a comparative project between São Paulo and London, analysing spatial patterns of policing in large metropolitan areas and how neighbourhood context shapes the ways police engage with local populations.
